issues.problem: Two problems with the new audience busts. (a) In the medallion push close-up (+16.4 to +26.0; full frame at +20.3), the near-row busts fill the bottom fifth of the frame at large scale, and their profiles read as figures in baseball caps. The 'parted' variant's crown dip sits forward over the brow, and with the nose it makes a brim. The 'bun' reads as a cap button. This is the only place the crowd is seen this close, and it undercuts the Versailles dignity. (b) In the wide (+13.2 to +18.5; full frame at +14.58), the busts framed inside the arched windows (y about 52-70%) are drawn larger than the front-row busts at the bottom edge (y about 80-95%). Scale should grow toward the camera, so the hall's depth reads backwards.
issues.fix: (a) In the push, either drop the near row below frame (lower it 60 px and let the medallion own the frame), or redraw the parted variant with the dip at the crown's top-back and a hairline that meets the forehead, with no forward overhang. (b) Scale the arch-row busts to 0.75x of the front row and drop them about 15% in value toward the wall. Verify stills at +14.6, +20.3 and +25.5.

issues.problem: The film's last action, the match strike (+19.8 to +22.9), now uses an articulated pinch. Even so, the hands are carved-mannequin blocks: square finger segments, a flat palm slab, and on the grip hand a cuff rectangle that floats beneath the palm with a visible gap (frame at +21.4). On a 1280 frame each hand is about 170 px tall, so this is the largest silhouette in the closing minute, and it is the furthest thing in the film from the reference's fine-cut lace cuffs.
issues.fix: Cut the fingers as tapered paper pieces (rounded tips, a knuckle notch per finger, a thumb with a visible web). Join the cuff to the wrist with one continuous sleeve edge, so no slab floats and no gap shows, and keep the 2 px warm rim on the lit side. Scale both hands to about 0.85 so the candle and the lit window keep the frame. Keep every timing ('suspicious' in, ignition on 'new', flare on 'candles'). Verify stills at 20.5, 21.4 and 22.8.

issues.problem: From 'fence' (+13.75) to the pull-back (+18.8), the far paper fence reads as nine blank white slips on a line hung mid-frame between the gap taper and the chokepoint candle (full frame at +14.5). They have no texture and sit at the candles' own depth, overlapping the 2022 candle's column, so they look like placeholder cards rather than a far fence. Above them, the three s04b dissent tags hang at about 25% ink and cannot be read (HELPS HUAWEI / SELF-DEFEATING / DECISIVE are only smudges). issues.fix: Push the fence back to the far-shore plane: blur it by 1.5, scale it to 0.75 and seat its tie line on the horizon behind the candles (occluded by them, not overlapping them). Give each sheet two faint ruled lines at 30% ink so it reads as paper. Either drop the dim dissent tags (s04b has already shown them) or bring them to readable ink in one row clear of the fence. Verify stills at 14.0, 14.5 and 16.7.

best_moments: ch15-s09: the CASE FILE, now stamped squarely STATUS: OPEN under the verdict slip, then black with a single cyan cursor, then the neighbour's lamp across the street. The match catches on 'new', and the new taper burns beside the 2025 stub with its year tag still blank. It is the film's thesis in one image.

ch13-s04: three camps on one stage under the checker floor. Gebru's hand at her chin, LeCun lit alone by the server rack, and the three Turing medals descending on 'medals' between the two signers and the one who stood apart. This is the closest the film comes to the reference's tableau staging.

ch15-s01: Hinton asleep in the 2 a.m. hotel room, the handset lighting on 'phone', then the Hall of Mirrors with JOHN HOPFIELD at the podium. The medallion push teaches the mechanism through the prize itself: the ball rolls into the dip on 'downhill', and the dots settle on 'cools'.

ch04-s07: a hard cut into the snow valley, the Helsinki window lit, and a single thread rising on 'thread'. A cut to the student's FORTRAN page (DO 20 highlighted), then the pull-back lights the valley's houses warm.
ch14-s04b: the struck match labelled COMPUTE MATTERS LESS? smokes out beside the two 2022 candles, and the three dissent tags hang as one equal row. It is fair, and it is quiet.

ch11-s03: the jug pours light over the word drawers, 'tired' 56% slots into the sentence, and the odds re-pour on 'again' (after 61%). The X-ray of the cabinet then reveals the machinery. It is the cleanest teaching shot in the film.
ch15-s08: the evidence board rewires itself into the lantern net on 'The board was a network all along'. The dark lantern is left at the centre, and STATUS: OPEN strikes on 'open' with its clack.
